title: Three Rotated Anisotropic Ellipses
intuition: Three equal-mass 2D Gaussians stretched along horizontal, vertical, and diagonal axes. Tests full 2x2 covariance fidelity so that matching a wide principal axis cannot hide collapse along the narrow axis.
failure_mode: Scalar-trace isotropic covariance trackers or misallocated prototype mass distort ellipse eccentricity and violate component_covariance_error or mass_tv.
